gen-dafont-groovy-gf-nokora: Groovy squeezes its c almost shut and spaces its lowercase loosely. Nokora adds a sans with a generous s and a thick, dark stripe of lowercase, so tight and open shapes trade places down the page.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Funky, loosely spaced and nearly sealed in the c, Groovy has real personality. And it earns its keep big and short, with Noto Kufi Arabic handling the sans-serif text in open, modern shapes.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans: Friendly and funky, Groovy pinches its c to a slit and spaces its lowercase loosely across the line. Noto Sans then carries paragraphs smoothly, its lowercase large and its c wide.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Friendly, funky Groovy squeezes its c nearly shut. Noto Sans Adlam, a sans with curve endings held well apart and tall, full lowercase, gives that tight heading open shapes to lean against.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unj: Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined is modern sans-serif with generous gaps at curve ends. Groovy is best at friendly, funky character with a nearly shut c, while the body font is best at staying open and level in height.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-anatolian: Funky and loose, Groovy nearly seals its c, with tracked-out lowercase and arms and legs of constant width. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs opens up, tips pointing outward, x-height lofty.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Friendly and funky, Groovy keeps its strokes flat and unmodulated, with a loosely tracked lowercase and a c almost closed. Noto Sans Arabic, the sans-serif, wins on wide openings and a tall x-height.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-armenian: A c that nearly seals itself defines Groovy, whose loosely tracked lowercase has terminals ending as wide as they began. Tight meets open: Noto Sans Armenian rounds out wide.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Noto Sans Avestan reads modern and clean, its curve tips never touching and its x-height pronounced. Groovy, though, does its best with thick-jointed strokes and a c squeezed nearly shut.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Loose, funky and nearly sealed at the c: that's Groovy. Noto Sans Balinese gives each curve breathing space and keeps its ascenders short, so the two sit together without crowding.
